purpose: Map historically implemented Project-Frankenstein mechanism families into explicit current EntityOS/HCU reuse decisions. This matrix is a research/navigation artifact, not runtime authority and not proof that any mapped mechanism currently passes executable acceptance.

current_product_target.module_boundary_rule: Preserve required cognitive functions, state transitions and evidence constraints; do not preserve historical biological/service module boundaries merely for naming continuity.

decision_vocabulary.REUSE: Preserve the mechanism/constraint substantially as a current design primitive or conformance requirement, while still requiring implementation-specific validation.
decision_vocabulary.ADAPT: Preserve the useful function but change representation, authority boundary, implementation or module topology to fit current EntityOS/HCU.
decision_vocabulary.RETEST: Do not promote by default; retain as an empirical candidate whose current value must be established by a discriminating executable test.
decision_vocabulary.REJECT: Do not carry forward the mechanism except as negative evidence or a regression target.

promotion_law: current durable state/evidence authority must remain deterministic
model/grid/workspace/J-Space outputs remain candidate/projection/measurement unless separately admitted
effect requests remain distinct from verified effects/results

must_not_preserve_blindly: implicit state reconstructed from prose when exact durable state is available
evidence_basis: current owner target requires complete Zero/EntityOS cognitive function reproduction on variable N
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Cognitive-process census -> ABI mapping -> lesion each migrated loop under matched tasks and prove required state/action/outcome behavior survives without the historical daemon topology.

must_not_preserve_blindly: historical vector dimensionality as sacred semantics
hard-coded architecture/personality labels that can override trained behavior
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Hold canonical state fixed while varying truthful-minimal, truthful-rich, stale and shuffled projections; verify durable state identity and measure downstream behavior changes without prompt-state leakage.

must_not_preserve_blindly: gains not coupled to actual admission/uptake
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Typed completeness tests plus matched ablation showing selected Entry state changes workspace uptake and later decisions; missing or ambiguous required fields must fail closed.

must_not_preserve_blindly: broadcast-only implementation presented as full GWT
textual recurrence treated as causal uptake
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Instrument candidate competition -> selection -> broadcast -> receiver uptake -> changed downstream cognition -> outcome -> verified re-entry; run lesion/shuffle/rescue controls.

must_not_preserve_blindly: completed training treated as behavioral PASS
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Freeze raw->transformed training lineage, family-separated splits and baseline evaluation; promote only if the specialized model improves target cognitive functions while retaining protocol/logic behavior.

must_not_preserve_blindly: shared source/model repetition presented as independent replication
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Lesion, truthful-vs-shuffled state/re-entry, fixed-model content control and counterfactual replay with explicit causal-use traces.

historical_function_to_preserve: separation of canonical semantic state from presentation text
must_not_preserve_blindly: stale prompt literals as architecture authority
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Successor-dynamic regressions derive expected authority from the newest canonical source rather than the validator's own constants; stale/shuffled projection tests must not alter canonical state.

historical_function_to_preserve: broad application/interop coverage as conformance demand
must_not_preserve_blindly: new language semantics for every integration
application-list breadth presented as executable support
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Executable conformance corpus across filesystem/database/web/system/tool families; introduce new language semantics only when a minimized counterexample proves compiler/runtime/FFI/stdlib cannot express the requirement.

must_not_preserve_blindly: retrieval miss/ambiguity silently converted into context
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Family-separated fixed-query benchmark comparing bounded fused retrieval against semantic-only and unconstrained graph baselines while preserving exact canonical-row/provenance/epoch binding.

historical_function_to_preserve: habituation/boredom signals as candidate control features
evidence_basis: current owner target requires outcome reconciliation and retry/recovery cognition
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Matched reactive-only versus explicit prediction-error/reward-state control on recovery, replanning and next-action quality; disable if no incremental value after equalizing compute/context.

must_not_preserve_blindly: oversized policy relative to observed reward signal
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Cold/warm/rejoin and lesion comparison against deterministic/simple selection baselines under fixed reward-signal volume; scale capacity only after measured need.

must_not_preserve_blindly: rich ambient prose injected into every model context
historical room ontology when not task-relevant
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Truthful-minimal versus truthful-rich versus shuffled spatial/world projections under fixed canonical state; retain only state dimensions with measurable task value.

must_not_preserve_blindly: replay that amplifies contaminated or noncanonical memory
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: Bounded replay/consolidation ablation with contamination controls, exact source/state identity and interrupt/restart/rejoin acceptance.

must_not_preserve_blindly: task completion based only on narration
service-local project state becoming a second truth store
evidence_basis: current owner target explicitly includes goal/state maintenance, planning, tool/action proposal and outcome reconciliation
mechanism_inheritance.next_discriminator: End-to-end goal -> plan -> authorized action candidate -> effect/result -> observed completion -> durable goal-state update, with unknown outcomes and stale capability claims failing closed.

cross_cutting_current_inheritance.boundary: Does not select a specific DB schema or prove storage/runtime performance.
Method presence does not fill missing facts.
N-independence and scaling remain executable acceptance gates.
No hidden-state/activation access to Claude Code may be assumed.

open_gap: This matrix covers the mechanism families currently indexed in MECHANISM_INDEX.json. The architecture-archaeology protocol requires a broader exhaustive historical inventory before harness release claims; missing mechanism families and missing dedicated histories remain open.
